main.description: Assert a manufacturing FACILITY into the kotoba Datom log (:plant/*). Disclosed public facilities only; coordinates rounded to ~0.01° (city/campus, G1). The operator is a COMPANY (joins kabuto org.corp.*), never a person (G4). headcount is the DISCLOSED AGGREGATE facility-employment figure — a SIZE, like floor area or market-cap; there is NO per-worker field anywhere in this lexicon and an individual worker is structurally unrepresentable (G4 — Charter Rider §2(c) reciprocity axis; Wellbecoming §1.13).

operator.description: :plant/operator — a company org id (joins kabuto org.corp.*), never a person

region.description: sub-national region / city (coarse; never a precise street address)

products.description: disclosed product CLASSES only — never a confidential recipe (G9)

headcountEst.description: DISCLOSED AGGREGATE facility employment (a SIZE) — NOT per-worker data (G4)

txCid.description: kotoba transaction CID (content-addressed Datom log; ADR-2605312345)
